name: Jerimie Kraushaar
prior_offices: Hot Springs County sheriff (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026; listed on the official sheriff page)
background: Jerimie Kraushaar is the Hot Springs County sheriff and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official sheriff page lists him in that office. Independent Matt Wheeler also appeared on the 2026 general-election ballot and lost.
